highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with a reworked singleton lifecycle.
highlights_body: It carries forward variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, controllable surface sampling, and expanded native assets. This is a breaking release: legacy paint APIs become compile errors, several defaults change, and Ganesh Vulkan now requires Vulkan 1.1.

breaking.title: Legacy paint, text, glyph, and sampling APIs are now compile errors
breaking.body: Long-obsolete SKPaint text/font members, paint-only text and shaping overloads, legacy filter-quality overloads, SKTypeface glyph helpers, selected run-buffer methods, and old backend-render-target constructors are removed from the reference assembly. Move text state and glyph work to SKFont, pass SKTextAlign and SKSamplingOptions explicitly, and use the documented replacement constructors and span properties.

breaking.title: SKFont defaults to an empty typeface
breaking.body: A parameterless SKFont now uses SKTypeface.Empty, so text measurement returns zero and drawing produces no glyphs until a typeface is assigned. Construct SKFont with SKTypeface.Default or another explicit typeface.

breaking.title: SKPaint and missing-family typeface defaults changed
breaking.body: A new SKPaint now exposes SKTypeface.Default instead of null, and SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns the default face for an unknown Android family. Stop using null to detect these states; use IsEmpty where appropriate or call SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily when a strict missing-family result is required.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move rejects offsets outside Int32 range
breaking.body: The obsolete SKStream.Move(long) overload now throws OverflowException for values outside the native 32-bit range instead of silently truncating them. Validate the offset and call Move(int).

breaking.title: Ganesh Vulkan requires Vulkan 1.1
breaking.body: Creating a Ganesh Vulkan context for a Vulkan 1.0 instance can terminate the process instead of returning null. Create the instance with Vulkan 1.1 or later and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the matching value; use raster or another backend on Vulkan 1.0-only hardware.

breaking.title: Vulkan backend interop structs changed
breaking.body: GRVkBackendContextNative removes fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice; use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures or fDeviceFeatures2 where applicable. GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo also gains Components and changes layout, so update manual struct initialization and native interop.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo renamed to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo, and the old type loses its value-equality surface. Update source references and equality logic to use the new type.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only
breaking.body: The protected setter is removed, so subclasses can no longer change IgnorePublicDispose after construction. Supply the disposal policy through the constructor path instead.

breaking.title: Pre-.NET 8 WebAssembly native assets removed
breaking.body: The WebAssembly packages no longer include native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later.

breaking.title: 32-bit Tizen native assets removed
breaking.body: The EOL tizen-arm and tizen-x86 assets are no longer shipped. Move Tizen applications to tizen-arm64 or tizen-x64.

breaking.title: Assembly version moved to 4.x
breaking.body: SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.148.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and hard-coded assembly-version checks.

bullets.lead: Skia updated from m119 to m148
bullets.detail: The bundled engine advances through m132, m133, and m147 to m148, bringing newer image-codec orientation handling, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, and upstream raster, region, runtime-effect, and filter fixes.
SKColorType.RF16 exposes Skia's single-channel 16-bit half-float red format for raster and GPU workflows.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: SKTypeface, SKFontArguments, and HarfBuzzSharp gain APIs for querying variation axes, selecting design coordinates, choosing palettes, and overriding palette colors.

bullets.lead: Sampling options for surface and bitmap draws
bullets.detail: New SKSurface.Draw, SKCanvas.DrawSurface, and SKCanvas.DrawBitmap overloads accept SKSamplingOptions for explicit filtering and mipmapping.
SKWebpEncoder can encode single images or frame sequences to animated WebP through span-based frame APIs.
SKStream.GetData() returns the backing SKData when the native stream can expose it without copying.

bullets.lead: Additional document, GPU, mask filter, and color APIs
bullets.detail: Adds SKDocument XPS creation overloads, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, shader-backed mask filters, SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, and the HBColor value type.

bullets.lead: Pixel spans honor row stride and coordinates
bullets.detail: SKPixmap and SKBitmap GetPixelSpan methods now use RowBytes and the correct axis when calculating offsets and lengths, including shared-buffer subsets.
Default typeface resolution moves to the managed font manager, preventing Android and NanoServer startup crashes and using an empty face when no system font is available.

bullets.lead: Variable-font spans and glyph checks corrected
bullets.detail: Undersized variation buffers now report and copy values correctly, and the byte-span ContainsGlyphs overload no longer recurses until a StackOverflowException.
SKPath no longer touches a finalized SKPathBuilder when garbage-collection order disposes the builder first.

bullets.lead: Android and WinUI rendering startup fixes
bullets.detail: SKGLView renders after MAUI TabBar reattachment, and .NET 9 WinUI consumers can resolve the packaged Projection assembly.
Process-wide wrappers initialize lazily without static-constructor cycles, no longer free shared native singletons, and remain alive across native calls.

bullets.lead: Native compatibility check delayed until first API use
bullets.detail: The compatibility gate now runs through the SkiaApi type initializer, allowing applications to configure native-library resolution before the first P/Invoke.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen native assets
bullets.detail: Adds linux-bionic-x64, linux-bionic-arm64, tizen-x64, and tizen-arm64 assets while retiring the EOL 32-bit Tizen targets.
WebAssembly native packages retain Emscripten variants for .NET 8 and later and issue a clear build error for older target frameworks.
Apple libraries target the base 26.0 platform versions, avoiding an unnecessary requirement for Xcode 26.2.
libexpat 2.8.1 brings upstream security hardening, while libpng, zlib, FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, and HarfBuzz also move to newer bundled releases.

contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and compiler support for legacy target frameworks
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone updates, variable fonts, default typeface handling, the SKPath finalizer fix, and singleton lifecycle work
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: The Android SKGLView reattachment fix for MAUI TabBar navigation

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.summary: Updates the bundled engine through Skia m147; adds variable fonts, color font palettes, controllable surface sampling, CICP color spaces, Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets; and fixes Android typeface initialization and SKGLView reattachment. It removes 32-bit Tizen assets, changes font and paint defaults, and makes SKStream.Move reject offsets outside the Int32 range.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.summary: Adds animated WebP encoding and zero-copy SKStream.GetData(), fixes the SKPath finalizer crash, and corrects Apple library target frameworks.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.summary: Removes pre-.NET 8 WebAssembly native assets, adds HBColor plus XPS, GPU flush, and shader mask-filter APIs, fixes NanoServer font initialization, and refreshes bundled image and font dependencies.

v4.148.0-rc.1.2.summary: Updates to Skia m148 with RF16, reworks singleton lifecycles, promotes legacy SKPaint APIs to compile errors, removes the IgnorePublicDispose setter, fixes pixel-span stride and offsets, and restores WinUI projection loading.

harfbuzz_summary: Bundles HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 with improved OpenType shaping and CFF2 subsetting, plus variable-font APIs, color font palette access, HBColor, and expanded Linux and Tizen native assets.
